parameters.name: ContainerGroupId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) on which the CommitContainer node is executed.

You must specify at least one of ContainerGroupId and TaskId for the query.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the previous API call.

parameters.name: TaskStatus
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:

- Running
- Succeeded
- Failed
